exposure: reasons for refusal (e.g., fear of side effects)
outcome: refusal rate of postpartum Intrauterine Contraceptive Devices (PPIUCD)
cohort: The study included 400 antenatal women attending a tertiary care centre.
finding: Despite good knowledge of PPIUCD, the refusal rate was high, with the commonest reason being fear of side effects.
mod_finding: 17.3% of subjects knew that copper T could be inserted during a cesarean section.
cross-section timing: Antenatal period, from November 2023 for 2 months
